description: This file defines a PHP class `VacancyMenuConfigurator` within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. The class implements configuration for the vacancy menu, overriding the screen to 'viewJobVacancy'. It uses certain traits and interfaces from the OrangeHRM core modules.

classes.name: VacancyMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration for the vacancy menu in the recruitment module, allowing customization of the menu screen.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the default menu configuration to set the screen to 'viewJobVacancy' and returns null.
